This Week in Review

Mailchimp campaigns wrap every content block in a role="presentation" table for email-client layout compatibility - none of these carry a <th> or scope/headers attribute, so they should all unwrap to plain content. This fixture is originally authored to exercise that pattern, not copied from any real campaign.

A second content block, in its own layout table, the way Mailchimp emits one table per drag-and-drop block in the campaign builder.

Unsubscribe from this list.
